mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day returns, with lower rates reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and predicting positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or FEDFUNDS level shows no significant inverse correlation with 20-day returns (p > 0.05) in rolling 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 315, persistent inflation triggers central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 315 periods, 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE indicates tightening monetary policy amid strong labor market conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 5-day returns due to heightened risk aversion.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling periods, 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor market regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), declining unemployment signals robust economic conditions triggering central bank rate hikes, predicting negative S&P 500 20-day returns due to reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 4.0 periods, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1350 thousand units, strong housing market activity signals economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 60-day returns due to improved consumer confidence.
failure_condition: In HOUST > 1350 periods, 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively correlated with S&P 500 60-day returns, as higher output reflects strong economic activity supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or INDPRO level shows no significant positive correlation with 60-day returns (p > 0.05) in rolling 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 710000 million dollars, strong housing market activity signals economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 20-day returns due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: In RSAFS > 710000 periods, 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above current levels indicates a robust housing market, predicting positive S&P 500 20-day returns due to sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed current levels, 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
